The waiter put down the bill our desserts haven't come out yet we were only given our coffees and cappuccinos. The desserts came out with a bit of delay. I would have taken an order of tiramisu to go but don't wanna test the temperament of our waiter so I opted not to get anything to go. Everyone loved their desert! We were still drinking our coffees and my friend was still eating here dessert and the busboys were rudely taking away dishes not even asking if we were done ( there was still some ice cream we were all picking on). But the kicker here was my friend still had tiramisu  on her fork  and her plate and they took her plate away!!! 

Never in my life had i ever gotten this kind of bad service at a sit down restaurant before. The food was good not great and definitely not good enough to return. Unless you have been coming here for years maybe they treat you better but new customers don't seem welcomed here. 

I can understand you have a long line out the door but we had a bill that came close to 500 dollars it's not like we were ordering water and bread just sitting there to be pushed out the door. Never again would never go there again.

First here here (with 5 others for lunch)
Cash only. There's an atm at the neighboring key food thank goodness 
Family style - huge portions. 
Just a little surprising - they don't do hot antipasto, shrimp parm, no oil for the bread on the table, (and not the greatest bread at that) no alcohol except beer (only Peroni) and home made red and white wine. And NO coffee. Just cappuccinos and espresso!!!!! What's that about!!

Anyway - amazing rigatoni, cold antipasto which they call something else (nobody understood that ) like a special house salad with meat and cheese , delicious shrimp maranara , and fantastic chicken parm. Plus the staff has a little attitude. 
Tartuffo and cannoli both good. 
I'll stick to Parkside or Michael's of Ave R.

Ok.  I've been here once before many years ago, so when we were nearby...my friend and I chose this as our dining destination!

Totally man run, old school Italian establishment and CASH ONLY, located in a neighborhood in Ozone Park. 

I called ahead to see if we needed a reservation.  The answer that night was "No".

We arrived and were greeted by two guys at the door.  Promptly seated in a table for two.  It is GREAT!  Big open room filled with probably mostly locals and lots of happy noise.  No background music.  Just engaged conversations and laughter!

It's like stepping into an episode of the Sopranos!  Dinner and a show!  Just fun!

Wait staff is all male.  Cook staff is all male.  Lots of men.  White shirts.  Black pants.  Ties.  "The look!"

Our fabulous waiter was Benny!!  He asked if we had ever been here before.  When I said I had he said, "Well, nothing has changed...".  Menu is on a board.  Food might seem pricey but everything is served family style.

We were given fresh baked bread & butter.  Menu is on a board.  We started with homemade wine & a salad.  It was iceberg with tomatoes, red onions, pickled red peppers & two types of olives...black & green.  The dressing was homemade...light and refreshing...took me straight back to my childhood...before dressing came in plastic bottles.

For entrees we selected chicken parm and a fresh pasta with red sauce.  Both were exceptional and I think we took home more food than we ate.

For dessert we selected limoncello sorbet & tiaramisu and they were divine!

Try it - you'll like it!!

Place is a dump. Food is very over rated and only by people who dont know good food. Staff is nasty and they rush you out the door like they didnt even want you there. Very expensive and quality is garbage. Had a bad experience a while ago and decided to give them another shot but they got even worse. Wont be coming back or recommending to anyone.
family style l, delicious and nice portion. they have house wine and the waiter is very friendly too
Food is fresh and delicious.  Will visit again in the near future. Thank you for a great experience.

Only cash accepted and the sign that says that is really small, the menu is hanged on a wall and to read it you have to stand up and get closer.
There isn't an ATM in the restaurant (or at the entrance) and you have to look for one in the neighbourhood. Staff kind of rude, food is good
Voted as one of the top 7 Old World Italian Style restaurants.  Family style and the food is delicious- cash only and no reservations though:(

Tonight I decide to eat out for the first time in a month. I know the restaurant business got destroyed and try to patronize when I can. This is my last review for a very long time as I no longer see value and would rather go to Costco and buy premium food at a low price and cook it myself. Tonight I ordered Spaghetti with meat sauce for a main entree. It was fairly priced in my opinion. After eating this meal about 30 minutes later I had bad diarrhea. The pasta was fair and the meat sauce bland. But no complaints as I really didn't expect a real great meal as restaurant have really had to cut back. I had a bowl of Raisin Bran for lunch and a honey maple Boars Head Turkey for lunch as I have this 2-3 days per week. The meat sauce was probably simmering since Friday etc. I wish I could give this restaurant zero stars because that's all they deserve. Always a waste of money eating out these days.

I have a 2 because the food was actually good. The problem is it's cash only and we didn't know until time to pay. There is a tiny sign as you walk in but we never seen it. Next problem, don't ever order anything from the menu on the wall that says MP or market price. Usually market price is more than normal the steak I ordered was market price, I didn't ask the price but wow I should have. They charged me $150 for one steak yes $150!! I didn't have that much cash so they sent me to the lobby to find that ATM didn't work. I then had to go to the store a half block away to use that ATM and it didn't work. Luckily my friend was able to get the cash. We will never go here again. Please be aware when eating here.
great food, incredible vibes. the service and quality is incomparable. don pepes always had your back
One of my friends was refused service for no reason. He felt they profiled him, since they gave him no reason.

We live on Maui, HI.  We like to travel.  We make it a point to do a layover in NY when we fly to Europe.   We do this so that we may eat at Don Peppe.  It is truly a great experience.  Best food ever and the staff are incredible!!!!!

A great Italian place that reminds me of Italy a lot! The service, food, wine etc..

I would recommend if you prefer traditional Italian food. Service is not great but atmosphere is spot on with Italy!
One of the few authentic Italian restaurants left here in South Ozone Park. It's mostly all family style and I think they still only take cash. The food is great and the hospitality is good as well.

Never made so many friends in a waiting area anywhere!
It started with announcing I was wait for friends to arrive to Mark.
Everyone that arrived had recommendations from previous visits.
I was getting hungry by the minute.
By the time I sat I ordered everything my table could handle and the couple we were vibeing with in the waiting area was sharing their dishes with us.
I think it was my birthday or at least it felt that way 

Try the baked clams!
Nice pasta. Good for families old school style plates x very good wine.. red or white you won't be disappointed... :) good to come once a while ;)
Amazing- as authentic as it comes.  I highly suggest for anyone flying through JFK.  Eggplant parmigiana was amazing-

Quintessential NYC Italian restaurant. It is definitely a bit off the beaten path. Parking isn't great in the area but you might be able to find something a block or two away from the restaurant. Wine was house wine, no beer or hard liquor. Portion sizes were big and food was tasty.

Old school Italian restaurant.  Menu on the back wall.  Friendly efficient servers.  Food served family style.  Our table of 8 had steak pizzaole, shrimp Luciano over linguine, stuffed mushrooms baked clams and more.  Steak was excellent but the rest was just good (not great).  Local homemade wine was excellent.  Cash only!

Huge place but really comfortable and enjoyable. Food is good. Best place near JFK. Everything is family style and it seems like a really fun place to visit with a group. Recommend for the atmosphere alone.

Fantastic food , great neighborhood feeling. 
You wouldn't leave hungry. 
It's family style so go with a group.
Favorite of all times. Going there 30 years. Best linguini white clam sauce , veal Don peppe, baked clams and red vino you will be happy!

The food is decent nothing fantastic but definitely not bad, but I also have had better. 
CASH ONLY. No menu, there's a big board on the wall to which the servers point at when they come ask u for what u want. They expect you know what u want by the time they greet u, and if ur not ready they walk away like you said something horrible. 

Definitely overpriced, I don't mind paying overpriced when it's worth it. But if the food is good but the service is horrible, you feel rushed out once they feel like ur almost done also it's not even nice inside, looks like an old hall with tables and chairs.

I will definitely not come back here if I'm paying, and I won't recommend to anyone I know.

Outstanding service, food, wine etc.
Highly recommend this place for a terrific meal!

No reservations. Cash only. $$$$ Service is..... meh. Polite enough. Depends who's waiting your table. They take the whole order of the table all at once as I was told. 
I really love their food. We even had our wedding reception there many many years ago. 
$30 for 12 baked clams. $32 for the pasta with white clam sauce. Anything lemon butter is delicious. Zuppa di mussels. Come here for the food not service. Food is always consistently good.

Don Peppe's is and old stand-by.  A place that never misses, The food is great, so are the staff members, they have a great Home Made wine that is excellent and priced right. 
It's located off of the Belt Parkway, between Brooklyn, and Queens. 
Go if you get the chance.
Used to be awesome food and special almost iconic. Now very overpriced and mediocre. Serive ok but no wine choices. Food bland and expensive. Not returning.

Good food great service.   Cash only.  Bring a big appetite or a large group because it's family style. The steak pizziolo was so tender you could cut it with a fork.  They kept bringing bread. You'll deed it with all the flavorful sauces    We also had the linguini with clams and chicken don pepi both were amazing   Love this place!!!!!!!!

***CASH ONLY ***there's an atm at key food next door.

The guys are great, they get the job done. Tuesday night the place was packed. Bathrooms need a redo, then again the whole place could use some sprucing up.

Stuffed Artichoke wasn't as meaty as I would have liked but they're my fave so I didn't mind. The Linguini w/White Clam sauce was excellent. Perfect bite to the linguini. Their Eggplant Parm is prolly the best I've ever had. They throw it in the salamander to char the edges and they don't bread or fry the eggplant. The richness of the steak pizzaioli is truly special, but it should be for the price.

Cannoli was just ok. 

No reservations.

It has been a while since I was here so the review is based on what I can remember. The place had great vibes, very 'homey.' The service was phenomenal, everyone working there was very friendly. We got 2 pasta dishes and absolutely loved one of them, while the other one was just okay. Unfortunately I don't remember which ones. The portions are huge. Would definitely come back if ever in the area and wanting Italian food.

our last restaurant stop in our NY visit & the best ! The food was to die for , from the baked clams, veal parmigiana over spaghetti, bread & salad , wine to the CANNOLI for dessert , everything was delicious! The one thing I miss about NY ... great food. *Cash Only*

Bring extra cash and have a great meal . No cards 
  You will leave happy food is amazing here bake clams are a must and the shrimp Luciano everything really is outstanding . Enjoy

DO NOT EAT HERE. Food is genuinely bad and prices are out of control.

They scale price of item based on how many people are at your table, which they neglect to tell you. So don't order family style thinking you can try a bunch of dishes, as it'll be both way too much food and also ludicrously expensive.

Pasta was truly disgusting. Not a single dish was noteworthy.

Staff is rude. And actual restaurant is dirty and not well kept.

Overall, I do not recommend. Find a better place!

Been awhile since I was here, so I was excited to go for lunch today.  Homemade red wine was delicious.  Our waiter was very good. 
Got the baked clams, which were superb/top notch!
Next up, linguini with white clam sauce, which was sort of bland, and not like I remember.  (Almost like they added too much pasta water to the dish)
Chicken Don Peppe was your average fried chicken cutlet with bruschetta on top.  
Note: the bread they serve is some of the worst I've had.  I wish they would up their bread game, because I would've really enjoyed sopping up the juice from the baked clams, but didn't even finish 1piece of bread.  Contract with a local bakery to provide some quality crusty Italian bread and leave the bodega bread alone.

food- bakes clams, mussels, veal marsala, clams linguine, chicken don peppe, was good. ziti with sausage the sausage over cook no taste, chicken parm nothing special, penne with broccoli rabe, broccoli rabe mushes taste like it was frozen. waiter said need to order every dish one time only cannot order more later on. CASH ONLY.

Super delicious & authentic Italian food! My boyfriend has been talking about their baked clams for ages, and we finally had an opportunity to come here for dinner. There are no reservations, so show up EARLY because tables fill up quickly.

When placing your order, they only allow for you to order then and not later, so err on the side of caution and order a little more. Everything we ordered was absolutely DELICIOUS. The baked clams he was raving about? One of the BEST I've had - super garlicky, buttery, but you can still taste that perfectly cooked clam. At $30 for 12, the price seems steep but it's so worth it. All the pastas are delicious, but I particularly enjoyed the linguini with white clam sauce. I appreciate how our waiter warned us that 1 portion wouldn't be enough for our table of 10, so we ordered 2 (on top of everything else). Mussels here are huge and perfectly cooked, chicken parm was good, and the chicken Don Peppe was really enjoyable too. 

We were able to find parking pretty easily around this area. Make sure you bring cash - it's cash only!

Cash only. Family style. Great service. Food was incredible delicious and AUTHENTIC. Our waiter explained the menu very well. 

I can't wait to go again for date night or just dinner with friends. I went during the week so no wait time and were immediately seated upon our arrival.

Not sure where some of these bad reviews are coming from.  Could be the price - it's not cheap.  Is it the cash only requirement?  They are pretty clear about that, letting you know right up front that cards aren't accepted.

There were a few complaints in the reviews I read about how portions can be scaled upwards and the prices will change accordingly.  They didn't explicitly tell us this, but I figured anyone with common sense would know if you're getting chicken parm for 8 people instead of 4, it's going to cost double (or close to it).  Was someone seriously expecting to get extra food for free?

Maybe it was ambience - it's a loud space, plainly decorated.  Some said dirty or unkempt, I didn't get that at all.  It's plain - not a lot of decoration aside from some old horse jockey jerseys on the wall.

If you want old NY red sauce joint type Italian food, this is your place.  It was all great - from the baked clams and mussels marinara to the linguini with clam sauce and veal don peppe.  Be aware that your waiter will suggest add ons and expansions, which will cost you extra - and if that's a concern, ask what the change in cost will be.  Our bill ended up about 10-15% higher than the board prices would suggest, but we got extras (larger portions, some clams and shrimp thrown in to a dish that normally doesn't take them).

Go hungry and enjoy!

Food was good but service was not the greatest.. waiter was hard to understand, and was not able to understand what we wanted from the menu. I highly suggest a QR code for menu since we had to turn our backs to look at the menu and it made it uncomfortable - and it was $160 for 2 entree and one appetizer super overpriced- waiter was rude when we kept asking him questions about the menu as if they were not able accommodate to our needs

Old school red sauce Italian.  Portions are large - for 2-3.  Best to come with at least a few people. They don't take reservations.  IMO dishes were lacking enough sauce, such as the chicken Parmesan, and the shrimp over linguine. The sauce is excellent which is why we wish there was more.   The best dish was the linguini with white clam sauce.    Would go back for that.  The house red is chilled? And surprise - if you want your shrimp over linguine it's an extra $14 for a total of $47.  Not disclosed.

What a let-down! I'd been looking for a place with good linguini and white clam sauce and this restaurant was said to have the best. Since it only served family-style I had to wait until I could find a companion who also liked that dish and was willing to share it with me. Finally a friend agreed to come along on my quest.  I would finally get a chance to sample this place and its purported old school charm and huge servings. 

After seating us, a young waiter tried to get us to order more than one dish to share but we were just two people and we expected that one dish to be enough. (Little did we know....)

Next came the bread. Yuck. Not even toasted. Straight out of a supermarket. Disappointing but not what I came for. 

We waited awhile, though the restaurant was fairly empty. The server assured us that each entree was made to order and worth waiting for.

Finally the waiter put a dish of linguini in front of us. Was this the touted family-style dish??? It was in a small bowl and looked barely big enough to share. The server put some in our dishes and just a bit was left over. Definitely not enough for two. 

IF this turned to be the best linguini and clam sauce in Queens I would still have left satisfied but, sadly, it was far from it. It was fine but nothing special Definitely not something that I would return for. 

I left, still hungry, and still on the lookout for the best linguini and white clam sauce in Queens.

My friend and I went here Thursday just after 7pm and it was packed! There were prob 3 empty tables when we arrived so we got lucky and didn't have to wait. 

Let's keep this simple and to the point. This is a CASH ONLY, old school Italian, family style, great food, and dood service spot. It's definitely loud/bustling in here but we still managed to hear each other fine. The is one menu posted on the wall. I presume everyone here are pretty much regulars because our waiter came to take our order as if he expected we knew what they had/what we wanted. We pulled up the menu on Yelp!

I didn't see any drink/cocktail menu but we saw they had beers and wine so we ordered a bottle of Pinot Grigio ($30 I believe). Waiter didn't disclose the prices for anything so to avoid surprises, ask if you wanna be safe; we found out the prices of everything on the check (which is an old school, handwritten receipt. I don't recall the prices for everything but our final bill was $312; not too bad I think! The lobster tail fra diavolo was MP and I think it was $130 (pasta not included).

The bread to start was cold and blah! We ordered the mozzarella and tomatoes with peppers, stuffed mushrooms, baked clams, linguini with white clam sauce, and the lobster tail fra diavolo. We wanted the stuffed artichoke and whole lobster fra diavolo but they didn't have either. I loved the fact that everything is made fresh to order and our waiter paced each item and brought them out hot and fresh as we were finishing what we had on the table. The food is great and so filling! By the time the fra diavolo came out we were STUFFED so we took it to go. 

We definitely plan to go back to try some other menu items!

Been here twice. Large family style portions. Go with people who agree on what to eat. The cost will add up if people order different things only a couple people like or can eat. Food was great. I'm a finicky eater & have allergies. There was a nog compromise on the part of the people i went with, because I have allergies. Next time do homework, look at menu together, & decide what you will order, AHEAD of time. Long wait. Busy!! Cash only.
Nice portions, but I think over-rated, judging from the crowd; this place seems really popular.
Like being an extra in an episode of Sopranos except the food is real and it is excellent!

Was the best but took a terrible turn food stinks, clams were the best on the planet now terrible wine selection terrible this place is done what a shame , these guys took a staple and killed it very sad Don Pepe's is a done .

Excellent! The best! I Love the veal don Peppe along with seafood salad.
  Old school but top notch .
Been going to this place from Staten Island since 1996

I gotta come back more than once every decade or so... best Italian-American food in New York. Cool
staff as well.
Salad, baked clams, eggplant rollitini, linguine w clams, coffee and desert. Perfect. Just missed the anisette w my espresso but didn't ask for it (maybe thats just in Bensonhurst).

Don Pepe veal is so the way to go. Make the time to have a meal here before a flight from JFK, 8 minutes away.  Eggplant rolatini was well prepared as was ziti w broccoli.  Even if you don't have room for dessert have the fruit sorbets. Great taste and better presentation. Jury out on the red gravy, maybe a bit thin?  
Hard pass on the house wine.  I saw someone with their own bottle so will check on corkage next time. 
Waiter was very helpful. 
Cash only.

Old School, I walked in with a baseball hat on and was politely asked to remove it.  That was good enough for me but the meal that followed flat out just made me happy.  Beat that......oh and home made wine, boom.  Strangers but treated like regulars.  Will go back every chance I get.

Very NY Italian style & vibe restaurant.  Good Italian food.  Fun, old style waiters that will bust your balls if you try to get smart with them, but will take good care of you if you behave.  Come early and hungry because they dont take reservations and the wait can be long on a weekend, but well worth it.  Everything is fresh, so they can run out of dishes later in the evening.  We arrived at 6:30 on a saturday and waited about 45 minutes for a table.  They were out of salad by the time we ordered.  Still very happy with the stuffed peppers, veal parmigiana, and fettuccine al prosciutto.  Loved our waiter and food, definitely coming back.
Absolutely consistently delicious! The backed clams, Don Pepe salad, spaghetti with white clam sauce and veal Don Pepe are our favorites
Food was amazing.  family style and so much food. Definitely recommend. And when you go you have to have desert. I can't wait to go back.

Over rated from the moment we got in we were rushed didnt even give us water. The bread sucked for a famous italian restaurant the food was average at best definitely a tourist trap. I grew up in Queens and Brooklyn and live on Long Island I will not recommend so many better places to eat. So disappointed ive been wanting to eat here for years!

Stopped by on the recommendation of a friend who lives locally after the wonderful airline we were flying gave us a 7.5 hour layover. Glad we did as food was awesome and we sure didn't go hungry. The true Italian in our group of 6 says it was some of the best Italian food she has ever had.
Old school ny Italian at its best . All the classics are amazing ( baked clams and clam sauce especially) .

This is the best Italian food in New York. Every dish was mouthwatering. I would have this linguini with clams and baked clams for breakfast if I could. I was regretting not ordering more so we would have leftovers to take home. It was so good we cleaned every plate. Highly highly recommend. Bring cash.

greatest food ever!

real authentic italian food

must try the clams,    family style bring your appetite

The food snd service was excellent 
Really nice place. Would recommend the baked clams don peppe veal and pasta

Still the best family style Italian restaurant in New York. Still cash only.

There is one huge menu at the back of the restaurant. Make sure to bring your glasses if you're near sighted! I think it's the same menu from ten years ago. Be sure to ask about specials.

Limited options for beer and wine. There's house red, house white, and some macro beers like Peroni. 

Food wise, we started with the baked clams. They're served in a super savory, buttery white wine garlic sauce. Clams were meaty. Made sure to soak up the sauce with the bread.

Next we had the mussels. Similar to the clams, they were served in a buttery garlic sauce. Probably best to avoid your cardiologist for a couple weeks to allow your butter levels to return your normal. Nevertheless, we made sure to order another basket of bread and soak up as much of the sauce as possible. 

The next dish is one of my favorites: the shrimp Luciano. Shrimp over linguine with mixed and topped with caramelized onions in butter. I'm a big fan of caramelized onions and butter, so this one is perfect for me. I highly recommend it!

For the final dish, we had the veal Don Pepe. A veal cutlet pounded razor thin. Breaded, fried, and topped with bruschetta. A great change of pace to all the buttery dishes that preceded it. 

Service is very engaging. You certainly get that south Queens / southern Brooklyn charm. Lots of wittiness. 

As mentioned earlier, don't forget that it's cash only!
This place is not nearly as good as it used to be.  Infamous white clam sauce is now just average in taste.  Size portion is also a lot smaller.  Ordered a portion for 8 and it looks more like for 3.
Coming from a biracial couple and influencer... don't come here. Didn't feel welcomed. Food was bomb tho.
Great food Great service Moderate prices What is there not to like this place? Except that you can't boast to your buddies that you ate at Raos
Love this place!! I always order the langini in White Clam!! Amazing!! Family style eating; great experience. Highly recommend!!
The best Italian food you ever gonna eat. don pepe veal is my favorite, the mussels in white sauce is fire and i love the bake clams. cash only , family style

Definitely best for a large group of people due to price, be ready to spend $$$. Portions were family style and came plentiful. We had muscles in white wine sauce for app which were fresh and flavorful. Spaghetti with garlic and oil and the porterhouse steak. Everything was cooked really well and seasoned deliciously. Our server was attentive and served us each. Will come back and definitely recommend if you're looking to splurge on a meal
Lemon Butter veal was absolutely to die for. Also enjoyed the calamari marinara. Getting a table is tough if you're not there early. Go cry about it !

Old school restaurant  - yes they still exist!
Delicious family style food. Bring your appetite. 
For appetizers, we decided eggplant rollatini, baked clams, and a simple salad.
For the main course we decided on Veal parmigiana and Chicken Scarpariello . 
Our pasta choice was linguine with clam sauce and spaghetti with meat sauce. For vegetable, broccoli rabe . 
We chose the variety so that we could each indulge in all different dishes.
I would have to say of everything that we tried. The baked clams and broccoli rabe were actually the best. The other food was flavorful and hardy. 
For desserts, we tried a pistachio Tartufo, Peach sorbet (actually served in a real frozen peach). 
We also had some nice decaffeinated cappuccinos.
The service was spectacular and well worth trying this place to eat for a large group.
Keep in mind it is cash only and street parking can be a little bit challenging so plan on arriving a little early.
As good as it gets- old school cash only Italian joint where the baked clams are out of this world!

I went back because I had heard things had improved and they have. 
Food was as it once was.
Service is as it has always been, a 7.
Atmosphere seems to have improved, its cleaner, an 8
Love it for lunch.
Glad they shaped up

Let me make this easy.... OMG, seriously mind blowing good nope excellent. Stuffed artichoke, clams, pasta etc...close your eyes pick up the menu point your figure and whatever it lands on your absolutely delighted. ENJOY
non può andare meglio
Good place...cash only!  Very Italian family style. The food was really good. The waiter was great and very attentive.  One of the best Italian places.  On my 'must return' list.

Get ready to eat a large portion of food! Service is great and atmosphere is fun.  This is a true family style place where what you order is going to feed 3-5 people! The baked clams are by far the best they have to offer.  Highly recommend! The rest of the stuff is just ok.  The meat sauce is so-so.  The pasta (with onions btw) is not any typical Italian style I've tasted, but it was not bad.  Just not delicious for my liking.  CASH ONLY! No menu! The menu is on the wall and you order only once.  They do not mess around with this. Remember the soup guy from Seinfeld...don't mess! Prices are actually very reasonable considering the portions and family style serving.
Homemade family style food like nonna used to make!  Maybe the best clams oreganata on the planet!

Great restaurant. Absolutely give it a go. 

It's not "pretty"- you're not going to be taking Instagram pics here...but you're going to get great food (...and great portions!). The baked clams and linguini w clam sauce are excellent. CASH ONLY, don't forget!
Amazing Food and Amazing Service! We went here for a friend's birthday they did not disappoint!
All so delicious! Real cooks and chefs simply bringing it to Queens. Polite and professional service as well!

Consistently awesome 
Baked Clams best in the world
Shrimp marinara over linguini outstanding
Chicken Marsala melts in your mouth

I always love the ambience of this place. All of the staff are friendly and helpful. My favorite dish is the chicken don peppe - it's breaded chicken cutlet with bruschetta on top .. my mouth is watering just thinking about it. The best part is not just chicken but steak doesn't even need a knife to cut it .. it will cut with your fork like butter every time! Although I don't eat them due to seafood allergies, my family always talks about how incredible the baked clams are & have to get them every time we go. The red sangria is my go-to drink there. Truly a staple of South Ozone Park!
Fantastic food, thoughtfully served.   Have gone a few times over many years.  Always worth the time and effort.  Cash only.

First time visiting even though I have lived in the area all my life. Our waiter was great at explaining how much food we would need of each dish for our party of six. Everything was delicious! The calamari marinara is a must and if you like clams (I don't but the rest of my party did) they were the best anyone has ever had. There was an antipasto appetizer and it was delicious. We all shared the pasta with prosciutto, chicken Marsala and the veal don peppe. I am not a veal person and everything was light and delicious. Did not leave feeling overfull. Our only miss was the tiramisu.

Classic great dishes, loved it all 
Delicious experience !  Great to entertain family or clients, they cover it all
This food was delish! The service was awesome! Wish I lived closer to go more often. I'm glad I was able to go and I'll return when I'm back in NY.

who doesn't love a good linguini with white clam sauce? i keep hearing they make the best, so i was coming back from out of town and decided to grab an order to go as i was passing by on the belt pkwy. got home and opened the $37 tray and to my surprise there was very little clams, like barely any. it was a fine Aglio e Olio but i'll stick to popei's

Family style Italian cuisine.

Service was attentive.

Had the complimentary bread, followed by baked clams, portobello mushrooms and the daily special appetizer: crab cakes. Had the linguine with white clam sauce as our pasta course. Followed by chicken parmigiana and veal marsala.  

Tartufo and cappuccino for dessert with some anisette. 

Also, copious amounts of house red (grape juice). 

Bill, with tip, came to $121 a person (party of four).

Well worth it.

Finally,  after years of being asked by our  friends that live in Malverne to go with them to Don Peppes, we made it there this evening. There were 5 of us.  Everything is served family style so it took awhile to get everyone to decide what to order.  Everything sounded great.  We opted for the baked clams, a stuffed pepper, spaghetti with white clam sauce, veal & eggplant & the filet of sole.  The house red wine was delicious & served chilled.  Danny our server was attentive and expertly plated each course.  The baked clams were some of the best I have ever eaten.  The stuffed pepper was filled with veggies so it was light.  The pasta was perfect with nice slices of garlic.   The veal & eggplant was tender and delicious.  The fish was cooked to a tee. 
We made room for dessert & cappuccinos.  The coffee was a perfect ending to a great meal.  The cannoli had a crispy shell & creamy dreamy filling.

My favorite place! I love eggplant and chicken the roasted peppers 
Pasta any one is amazing

Oh Don Peppe where do I start? Our flight back home had been cancelled and in the chaos we were lucky and were able to grab a hotel room nearby. Both my lady and I were tired and hungry after napping we realized that in our week long stay in nyc we hadn't had any Italian food. We had done West Indian food, bagels, pizza, hot dogs but no New York City Italian?! For shame our ancestors from the old country would have yelled at us in Sicilian!
So realizing we were near Howards Beach and Ozone Park I started googling places. Looking on yelp I found that Don Peppe's was the number one ranked Italian restaurant in the area. So we said what the hell let's have a look. 
We got to Don Peppe's and immediately were treated by a man at the door dressed in street clothes who ushered us in. Did he work there? Was he just hanging out? Who knows.
We grabbed a table and saw that in this old school joint with walls adorned with horse racing jockey shirts that menus didn't exist. We looked across the half full restaurant and saw that instead the entire menu was on a board next to the kitchen.
Clam Linguini, Lobster, baked zitti and yes Veal Marsala to name just a few items on the menu.
Our waiter came over. Unlike waiters you see at some trendy joint who might be wearing some ridiculous outfit with antler tattoos on their chest this was a older fedressed in a simple white button up and black slacks. In other words this waiter was a pro of the old school variety. 
We asked what was good and in a non chalet way told us about what the place was known for. 
I asked about the wine and he said it's chilled red or white. That it came in a small bottle.  Which I imagine was home made but I wasn't entirely sure.
After a back and forth with my lady we decided on shrimp marinara to start, then for our main course clam linguini with a side of broccoli rabe. 
"Good choice,"our waiter said, "it's a lot of food so it's more than enough."
Words can't describe the food. The shrimp was done simply but. Oh so tenderly. While the broccoli rabe was done just right. But for me the highlight was the clam linguini. Unlike other places they already had taken the clam out of the shell. So there was no broken clam shells and you got more clams. Whole garlic clothes had been roasted in olive oil and had softened. If there had been the very idea of a cold inside my body it was destroyed by the beautiful strength of the garlic. 
The linguini with the wine left us both filled with joy. 
As we paid we learned that they'd be closed for the month. We were lucky. 
I looked over and saw some older regulars at a table playing cards. Having been around forever Don Peppe's felt less like a restaurant and more like a home. Generations had come here and would continue to come as long as Don Peppe's stayed open.

You want old style Italian with huge plates of scrumptious food? Stop searching, this is the place. Large room, busy, noisy, cash only, no cocktails! But their house wine is quite good. And their baked clams are hands down the best. As is their house salad. And everything else on their menu. Except you don't get a menu, you order off the large selection on the large sign on the wall. And you will probably never know about the day's specials unless you ask!
Food is incredible! Apps, Entrees and dessert all superb. Family style plenty to eat. Large selection of Italian classics. A must visit for Italian food lovers. I wish I could give more stars.

No reviewer can do Don Pepe justice. It's that good. Old style Italian. Cash only. Deliciousness only. 
Baked clams? We don't order them in any other restaurant (for almost 50 years now). Wine? Home made. I don't even like wine, but it's just plain perfect. 
Everything is served family style, but even the two of us leave no dish unfinished. It's. That. Good. Servers are friendly and professional. 
You don't know what you're missing.

You want old school Italian? This gem is your spot. We had a 5 hour layover in NY on the way to Paris so 6 of us headed there to eat after a recommendation from a friend! I'm so GLAD we did. You can tell nothings changed and the food is as good as it looks! Love the theme and I will be stopping next time I'm in the area - layover or not!

Went to Don Peppe's in S Ozone Park for the first time last night.  How did it take me so long.  AMAZING place.  Old school.  No reservations, cash only, waiters with ties, menu on a blackboard.  The food...OMG.  I had 13 baked clams all by myself (wife doesn't eat seafood).  Best I've ever had.  Actually worth $33 and the dipping the bread in the sauce was heaven!   Next was baked ziti (more like ziti with some cheese on top) but delicious.  Then chicken Parm.  Best I ever had.  All this for $100.  Half the food went home with us.  I will be back!

I cant believe Im writing a bad review for this place that me and my family have eaten in for about 50+ years. We havent been there in close to 8 years now but came to celebrate a big event. Shocked to see it half empty on a Saturday at 730. I remember the days of waiting an hour for a table. Our party of 4 was seated at a tight table at the back wall next to the kitchen even though so many other tables were available. Waiter came over promptly and took our wine order. Within minutes he asked for our order. We asked to order the apps first as we were deciding about mains. He said no it has to be done all together. Ok, give us a few minutes. We ordered baked clams and calamari, spaghetti garlic and oil and penne with broccoli, ckn with lemon and shrimp marinara. Waiter informed us we couldn't get penne broccoli it had to be spaghetti broccoli. You cant order 2 different pastas. WHAT!! Thats what we want. He insisted. So we only got the one pasta. When we asked about getting 2 half orders because portions USED to be huge, waiter said no half order but you can do an order and a half! WHAT!!
Clams came. Then spaghetti ENTREE. No calamari. Waiter said I bring it as it comes out of the kitchen. The spaghetti was such a small portion. Maybe half a pound for 4 people. Then the calamari app came. Also the family order of lemon chicken came with 3 pieces. How is that a family portion? Needless to say our $400 dinner left us hungry and unsatisfied. I dont know if it was a bad waiter or this is the new Don Peppes. Very disappointing and we will never go back again. Not to mention the place looks dirty and can use a paint job.
If you haven't had dinner at Don peeps my opinion is you haven't had good Italian food yet

Classic Neapolitan cooking. Excellent service. Stick to the classics and you can't go wrong. The clam sauce is among the best I've ever had. Veal scallopini. Among the sides I love the broccoli rabe and the string beans. And the ice cream balls encased in chocolate are a fabulous desert. Have you dreamed of dining at Rao's but can't get a reservation? Come to Don Peppe. Cash only.

I debated writing this review especially after reading mostly positive ones for this place....I was so excited to try it. Upon walking in, it was very awkward I can't explain it. All the waiters were sitting down (I've never seen that before in a restaurant whether it's slow or not).

We looked at the menu and agreed to just get one pasta dish and one appetizer. The waiter comes over and says there's no stuffed artichokes which is what we wanted I said what about stuffed peppers or what about a Caesar salad...they don't have that either. So now we just order a regular salad and a spaghetti with meat sauce because we are not the biggest fish people.

The salad came out pretty fast..it wasn't bad but not my favorite. But then it felt like almost an hour for our pasta to come out and I genuinely couldn't understand why when the restaurant didn't have that many people in it. Pasta was super salty and the meat was ok.

Ordered a lemon sorbet for dessert and it was alright, didn't taste fresh.

$110 later and we left hungry and confused. However, I will say our waiter was very nice and was making conversation upon our encounters.

Oh well!
awesome - the best - service and food was great - even the house wine was excellant.....................

Overpriced and way overhyped... the food was basic at best and the server was pretentious.... It was a good salad, the clam linguine was bland and fishy, Don Peppe chicken was pretty good but not great... How does an Italian restaurant only cary basic red table wine?!  I would never come back here and would not recommend this place with all the amazing options that are available in NYC!
Amazing food and service . Can't wait to go back and try other menu options. The house made wine is top notch.

Famous for their baked clams! They are great!
Rest of the food is great too!
Old school feel.
Don't  skip this place, it's very good.

It never fails to impress, nothing fancy but just good food and great service.
Please bring at least 3-4 friends and a big appetite, that being said the only downside is they don't take reservations or credit cards. That aside you can not beat the quality of the food and the fun you're gonna have eating here.
I would totally recommend this classic Resturant .

Some dishes were great some not so. But attitude-- we had an early reservation. Got there earlier. Restaurant was empty but we were not seated because the entire party was my present. Let me repeat the restaurant was empty

Got lucky with a table for 7. It was around 3pm and there were ppl already waiting for a table. Walking in was nothing out of the ordinary..menus are plastered on the wall. The chairs had rips in them. You would think for such a busy cash only business they'd put a little more effort in what the place looks like. Our server was excellent- he was constantly checking on us. The house wine was good. The food was excellent! The baked clams, antipasto, linguini in clam sauce, eggplant parm, chicken Marsala and broccoli everything was delicious. Except my brother ordered the lobster tails and they were horrible. No flavor at all and super tough. Ended our dinner with cannolis, cappuccinos and intermezzo. I would def come back here. The food and service were absolutely top notch. Keep in mind that everything is family style and the waiter usually decides how much he will order for the table.
Great food, great place, great family.   If you don't like the food here, put down your fork and get back on a plane at JFK and go back to whatever fly over state you came from.

An incredible Italian-American classic in Queens! I brought my nonno here, and even he had high praise for it. The restaurant doesn't have a physical menu--all the featured dishes are written on the wall (photo attached). Everything is served family-style, with your server plating it for you, which I thought was a really nice touch. It's cash only, so come prepared. 

I highly recommend the baked clams, calamari marinara, linguine with white clam sauce, and the veal Don Peppe. Everything we ordered, including their house wine (red or white), was fantastic. I can't wait to return.

I came to this classic Italian restaurant before Christmas with my Dad and family.  It was outstanding.  The ambiance and place hasn't changed at all. It's quintessentially old modern.  No menus only the black board which you need to stand up to read.  We had the baked clams and veal don peppe and linguine and clam sauce.  All were very delicious.   The service was very good with the waiter serving homemade red wine.  We will be back and don't forget cash.  No CC

Classic spot. Got seated quick for a party of 10.

Incredible spot. Loved the food and atmosphere when we were there for our time. They sent us an ice cream platter for the birthday boy.

Veal
Salad
Clam linguini
Baked clams
Calamari
Sausage broccoli florets
Baked mushrooms(I think)

Overall very good. Little pricey tho, our table of 10 came out to almost 1000.

Absolutely the best food,  The best house wine!!! Absolutely the WORST  customer experience. Full orders only, , no accommodations Cash only, extremely high prices and they are doing you a favor letting you eat their baked clams... 
If you like being treated like garbage, this is the place for you.
